# Tecsys

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store for notebooks, gaming PCs, components, monitors, printers and supplies, with some small appliances. Ships across Uruguay and delivers same day in Montevideo and Ciudad de la Costa.
